app.name: Dalail
onboarding.about1: Every answer comes from the written work of scholars and is checked by a scholar before it is shown.
onboarding.about2: Quran and hadith are shown exactly as they appear in the sources, with their references.
onboarding.about3: Everything works offline. Nothing you type leaves your phone.
onboarding.fullExplain: Your phone can run Full mode. For now Dalail finds answers with on-device search; the optional AI helper comes in a later update.
onboarding.liteExplain: Your phone will use Lite mode: fast on-device search, no AI helper. All answers are available.
onboarding.modelLater: Optional AI model download: coming in a later update.
